error.message: Live computer-use studies need E2B_API_KEY in the environment (values are never persisted). also checked .humanish/local/provider.env, ~/.e2b/config.json, gh auth token, and ~/.config/humanish/keys.env. Fill: E2B_API_KEY: run `e2b auth login`, or `humanish keys set e2b`.

caps sets a spend cap (maxUsd or maxTotalUsd), but humanish has no rate for model "unpriced-model", so it cannot enforce the cap and refuses to start. Priced models: computer-use-preview, daybreak-blue-latest, daybreak-red-latest, gpt-5.5, gpt-5.6, gpt-5.6-cyber, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-6-astra. Use one of them, or remove maxUsd and maxTotalUsd to run without a cap.
